en-US.title: [Korean Cuisine Cook Certification] 3-Minute Key Summary: Preparing Squid for Stir-fried Squid!
en-US.description:
[Korean Cuisine Cook Certification] Key Points for Preparing Squid ⬇️

1. Use Salt If It's Slippery 🧂

Salt isn't typically included in the seasoning for stir-fried squid, but it is provided in the ingredients list!

This is because if you hold salt in your hand while gripping the squid when it's slippery, you can peel the skin without it slipping. Please use salt 👍

2. Distinguish Front and Back! 📣

You must distinguish between the squid's internal organs and the skin side.

The internal organ side has bumps and marks where bones were removed! You must make incisions on the internal organ side to get a beautiful pine cone shape.

3. The Width Must Be the Length‼️

For those whose squid curls up like a spring instead of a pine cone when stir-fried 👋

To make it curl like a pine cone, the width must be the length! You must slice it lengthwise so that it curls nicely.

2. 스크램블은 센불에서 빨리🔥

스크램블을 약불에서 만들게 되면 수분이 나와 오믈렛 성형에 방해를 합니다💦
센불에서 팬과 젓가락을 서로 반대방향으로 빨리! 돌려서작은 입자의 스크램블을 만들어서 앞부분이 통통하게 팬닝해요

3. 바닥 통통 치기🍳

스크램블이 다 되면 바닥을 가볍게 톡톡 쳐서 밑에 있는 기공을 빼줘요
그래야 매끈한 스크램블이 완성됩니다🙂

4. 벽면에서 만들기🥚⭐️

가장 중요한 포인트에요! 팬의 벽면을 사용해서 만들어야 납작하지 않고 예쁘고 둥근 오믈렛이 나와요 그동안 내 오믈렛이 왜이리 납작하지? 생각 하셨다면 벽면에서 만드는 게 정답입니다🤫 팬을 기울여 한 번 도전해 보세요

5.스페니쉬 속재료 욕심 부리지 않기😗

속재료를 처음부터 많이 넣고 만들면 속재료나 수분이 새어나와 망할 가능성이 높아요🥲 속재료 양을 조금씩 늘려가며 연습해 보세요!

en-US.title: [Cooking Technician] Spanish Omelette in 2 Minutes!
en-US.description:
[Western Cooking Technician] Omelette Tips ⬇️

1. Be sure to coat the sides of the pan! 🧈

Omelettes require the sides of the pan, so
coating the sides is crucial! If the coating isn't perfect, it will stick and tear. 🥲
Coating is done by adding oil while the pan is fully heated!

2. Scramble quickly over high heat! 🔥

Scrambling over low heat will release moisture, which will interfere with the omelet formation. 💦
Over high heat, quickly rotate the pan and chopsticks in opposite directions to create a small scramble, ensuring the top is plump.

3. Plump the bottom! 🍳

Once the scramble is done, gently tap the bottom to remove any air pockets. This will ensure a smooth scramble. 🙂

4. Cooking on the sides! 🥚⭐️

This is the most important point! Using the sides of the pan will result in a beautifully rounded omelet, not a flat one. If you've ever wondered why your omelets are so flat, the right way to cook them is to use the sides. 🤫 Try tilting the pan.

5. Don't be greedy with Spanish fillings. 😗

If you add too much filling from the start, the filling or moisture will leak out, increasing the risk of a mess. 🥲 Practice gradually increasing the amount of filling!

#omelet #western #westerncooking #spanishomelet #cookingschool
